events.continuity_hook: Narrows the Phoenix lodging decision after the initial block-versus-Tempe comparison.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two hotel choices with estimated room, tax, and local-transport totals; note meeting access, breakfast, in-room coffee and refrigerator details to confirm, nearby dinner options, and cancellation timing; then recommend the lower-friction reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The Phoenix retreat organizer has confirmed that the Thursday morning advisory session will be in the downtown room-block hotel, while the lower Tempe hotel still has refundable rooms with breakfast. Current constraints are arriving Wednesday by late afternoon, avoiding a rental car, keeping the hotel total defensible once rideshares are included, and making sure dinner is simple after the hosted Thursday evening program. The unresolved choice is whether to reserve the downtown block before its cutoff or use the Tempe property and rely on light rail or rideshares.

events.continuity_hook: Moves from the Phoenix hotel hold to final flight selection.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh viable round trips, compare fare, total travel time, connection risk, margins around the retreat schedule, and Chicago arrival time, then identify the itinerary to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has placed the downtown Phoenix block room on hold and is ready to ticket airfare after the Friday planning session was set for 9:00 a.m. to noon with a possible short closeout afterward. Current constraints are leaving Chicago on Wednesday, landing by about 4:30 p.m. for the informal gathering, returning Friday after the closeout without a rushed airport transfer, and getting home before late evening. The unresolved choice is between a convenient nonstop and a cheaper connecting itinerary that lengthens the trip home.

events.continuity_hook: Checks the Phoenix trip once final addresses and the airline timing update arrive.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm that the updated flight timing still leaves enough arrival margin, outline the simplest airport and venue transportation plan, note any hotel room requests to make in advance, and decide whether to leave the bookings as they are.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Phoenix trip, the airline sends a minor schedule update and the organizer publishes final venue addresses. Current constraints are keeping the no-car plan workable, reaching the Wednesday evening gathering comfortably, getting to the Thursday community arts center visit on time, and making sure the hotel room has the practical basics she expected. The outbound arrival now slips by about twenty-five minutes, and the open question is whether the existing flights and hotel notes still work without changes.

events.continuity_hook: Begins the next spring grant-site episode after the Phoenix work trip wraps up.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact flight, hotel, and ground-transport comparison with estimated totals, meeting access, airport transfer time, breakfast, room amenities, nearby dinner choices, and a recommendation on whether skipping a rental car is realistic.
events.scenario_brief: After the Phoenix retreat is complete, Marisol starts planning a March 24-26 Kansas City grant-site visit involving a Thursday morning public art campus tour, a Thursday afternoon library partner meeting, and a Friday debrief expected to end before noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, avoiding a rental car if hotel location and rideshares are reasonable, keeping the nightly rate near the grant travel guidance, and returning Friday after lunch. No bookings exist, and the open questions are which hotel area best fits the two meeting locations and which flight times leave enough margin.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Kansas City lodging after the host pickup location and timing become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the hotel choices after taxes and likely local transportation, show the Thursday morning timing difference, list room details and cancellation dates to confirm, and recommend the more practical reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The Kansas City host has moved the Thursday morning pickup earlier and can collect Marisol only from the downtown or Crossroads area. Current constraints are avoiding an early long rideshare, keeping the hotel cost easy to justify, having a simple Wednesday dinner nearby, and checking whether the room includes breakfast, a coffee maker, and a mini-fridge. The unresolved decision is whether to book the slightly higher Crossroads limited-service hotel or a lower downtown full-service property that adds breakfast and room-amenity uncertainty.

events.continuity_hook: Completes the Kansas City travel plan after the hotel reservation and Friday agenda settle.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh Chicago-Kansas City round trips around the confirmed agenda, compare fare, travel time, airport margin, and Chicago arrival time, then identify the flight to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has reserved the Crossroads hotel for Kansas City and the Friday debrief is now confirmed for 10:30 a.m. to noon, with a casual lunch likely to run until about 1:15 p.m. Current constraints are arriving Wednesday with time for hotel check-in and an early dinner, departing Friday only after lunch, allowing a comfortable ride to the airport, and avoiding a late return to Chicago. The unresolved choice is whether the cleaner midafternoon nonstop is worth more than a cheaper later connection.
